availability_policy: SEC companyfacts has date-only filed fields tied to the Eastern Time filing day. available_at is next midnight America/New_York after filed converted to UTC (04:00 UTC in daylight time or 05:00 UTC in standard time); hosts lacking IANA timezone data use the conservative 05:00 UTC fallback. This is a public availability reconstruction, not an asserted dissemination timestamp. retrieved_at/as_of is actual current acquisition; do not pretend a present download was acquired in 2025 or February 2026.

comparability.locator: Explanatory Note; Item 7 Results of Operations; Note 2 Business Combinations
comparability.reason: Southwestern merger closed 2024-10-01. 2024 consolidated operating results include Southwestern only after close, while 2025 includes the full year. Changes in revenue, production, cash flow, cost and weighted-average shares do not establish organic growth. The two filings are comparable in tagged definitions and period length, but not in operating perimeter.

limitations: Historical replay reconstructs public availability and cannot certify contemporaneous source acquisition.
Annual consolidated revenue includes marketing, derivatives and other lines; a commodity model must use an attributable realized-price/netback bridge.
CFO minus this capex is a cash-flow arithmetic observation, not an unlevered valuation cash flow or maintenance-capital estimate.
Annual weighted-average diluted EPS shares, year-end issued shares, and later cover-page common outstanding shares are separate definitions; fully diluted current share count is unverified.
Only annual 2024 and 2025 filings are curated. This does not assert that 2025 year-end balances, cover-page shares or annual operations are current at October 2026.
No maintenance/growth capital split, complete equity claims inventory, market price, forward commodity price, or reserve-replacement economics are certified by this fixture.

Direct www.sec.gov archive HTML retrieval via Python received HTTP 403; the official filing was read through web browsing for definition and merger checks. JSON API collection succeeded and hashes are of actual raw responses.
